title: Ancient Egypt
description: A whole pub quiz about ancient Egypt: pyramids, pharaohs, gods and hieroglyphs.

questions.prompt: About how many kilometres long is the Nile?

questions.explanation: She took the throne in 51 BC and died in 30 BC.

questions.prompt: How many pyramids in total are known to have been built in ancient Egypt?
About how many workers are estimated to have built the Great Pyramid of Giza?
questions.explanation: Modern estimates favour a skilled workforce of about twenty thousand rather than the old picture of slaves.

questions.prompt: How many kings' tombs have been found in the Valley of the Kings?
In what year was the Rosetta Stone found?
questions.explanation: French soldiers found it near the town of Rosetta during Napoleon's Egyptian campaign.
